question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_season_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE cs.points > 0 AND r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
season_min AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_season_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_constructors AS (
    SELECT cst.constructor_id, cst.year
    FROM constructor_season_totals cst
    JOIN season_min smin ON cst.year = smin.year
    WHERE cst.total_points = smin.min_points
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) as seasons_with_min_points
FROM lowest_constructors lc
JOIN constructors c ON lc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY seasons_with_min_points DESC, c.name
LIMIT 5
